item.content:encoded:
原标题：Play OneBlock Online

作者：Cristina Anderca

原文：https://www.minecraft.net/zh-hans/article/oneblock-online

It starts with one block. I don’t know why, but no matter how many times I mine it, it doesn’t break. And yet my inventory is filling up with a variety of blocks?... It’s OneBlock, of course! This is the iconic Minecraft game mode that challenges you to expand your domain in the sky – now with friends! OneBlock Online not only introduces multiplayer, but also improved automation systems, long-term progression systems that will keep your island interesting for years to come, and more. Jump into this multiplayer adventure now via the Server tab in Bedrock Edition!

一切从一个方块开始。我不知道为什么，但无论我挖多少次，这个方块都不会破碎。然而，我的背包里却不断增加着各种各样的方块……当然是“OneBlock”模式了！这是Minecraft标志性的游戏模式，它挑战你在空中拓展自己的领地——现在还可以和朋友一起玩！“OneBlock Online”不仅引入了多人游戏功能，还提升了自动化系统，以及长期发展机制，让你的岛屿在未来多年里都保持吸引力。立即通过基岩版（Bedrock Edition）的“服务器”选项卡加入这场多人冒险吧！

Your OneBlock, islands, and co-op

属于你的“OneBlock”模式、岛屿以及合作体验

You start with a single OneBlock on your island, which progresses through 29 unique phases, each yielding increasingly valuable loot. We'll also add more phases, blocks, and items in future updates!

游戏开始时，你的岛屿上只有一个“OneBlock”方块，它会经历29个独特的阶段，每个阶段都会掉落越来越珍贵的战利品。我们在未来的更新中还会增加更多的阶段、方块和物品！

Aside from mining, you can complete daily and weekly quests to gain XP and spend it on permanent island upgrades such as increased island size, faster crop growth, improved spawner rates, and more!

除了采矿之外，你还可以完成每日和每周的任务来获取经验值（XP），并用这些经验值来升级岛屿，比如增加岛屿面积、加快作物生长速度、提高生物生成速率等等！

Plus, not only can you own multiple islands, but each island also supports multiple OneBlocks, so you can invite friends to join you so you can work together.

此外，你不仅可以拥有多个岛屿，每个岛屿还可以容纳多个“OneBlocks”区域，因此你可以邀请朋友加入，一起协作游戏。

Monster islands, bone forge, and enchantments

怪物岛、骨锻造厂以及制作魔法的工具（如魔杖等）

Want more loot than your OneBlock has to offer? Travel to a monster island and fight your way to rare drops and other rewards. Progress through increasingly difficult islands with custom monsters that bring some serious challenge to the OneBlock experience.

想要比“OneBlocks”所能提供的更多战利品吗？前往怪物岛，与怪物战斗以获取稀有物品和其他奖励。随着难度逐渐增加的怪物挑战，你的“OneBlocks”游戏体验也将变得更加精彩。

You can also collect resources to upgrade your gear via PvP (in a dedicated arena) and PvE (on the monster islands). Unlock powerful custom enchantments and armor set effects that allow you to personalize your gear to your playstyle.

你还可以通过 PvP（在专用竞技场）和 PvE（在怪物岛屿上）收集资源来升级你的装备。解锁强大的自定义附魔和护甲效果，让你的装备更符合你的游戏风格。

Island automation, customization, and cosmetics

岛屿自动化、定制化以及外观装饰

While you’re out adventuring, your island needs to stay productive – and that’s where the worker minions and automation come in. Minions are upgradable and customizable assistants that can help you with farming, chopping trees, harvesting crops, and killing mobs. You can also make them part of production chains in combination with items like chunk hoppers, auto-crafting chests, and auto-sell chests.

当你外出探险时，你的岛屿依然需要保持高效运转——这时勤劳的奴仆和自动化工具就派上用场了。这些奴仆是可以升级和定制的辅助角色，可以帮助你进行耕作、砍伐树木、收获作物以及消灭怪物。你还可以将它们与诸如区块传送器、自动制作箱和自动销售箱等物品结合使用，构建生产链。

But it’s not all about productivity! After all, what’s the point of having an island if you can’t decorate it? Visit the furniture shop to peruse a catalog of over 1000 items, as well as rotating seasonal furniture items for the collectors out there. You can also customize your character with chat titles, pins, wings, hats, chat colors, and more!

不过，这并不只是关于生产力！毕竟，如果你不能装饰自己的岛屿，拥有它又有什么意义呢？前往家具商店，浏览超过1000种商品，以及为收藏家准备的季节性家具。你还可以通过聊天标题、徽章、翅膀、帽子、聊天颜色等方式来个性化你的角色！

But that’s only part of what OneBlock Online has to offer. This multiplayer adventure also features a player-based economy, a rewarded leaderboard system, and server-wide events that range from fishing rewards to double XP and PvP competitions.

但这仅仅是OneBlock Online所提供的部分功能。这款多人冒险游戏还拥有基于玩家的经济系统、奖励排行榜系统，以及各种服务器范围内的活动，从钓鱼奖励到PvP比赛应有尽有。

Ready to become the ruler of your own island? See how far you can get in OneBlock Online!

准备好成为自己岛屿的统治者了吗？看看你在OneBlock Online中能走多远吧！

item.content:encoded:
原标题：Minecraft 26.3 Snapshot 7

作者：Java Team

原文：https://www.minecraft.net/zh-hans/article/minecraft-26-3-snapshot-7

Step up your building and exploring with the final features entering testing! You can now find different maps in some abandoned camps and craft Concrete Stairs & Slabs in 16 colors. Out now in 26.3 Snapshot 7!

随着最后一批功能的测试开始，进一步提升你的建造和探索技能吧！现在你可以在一些废弃的营地中找到不同的地图，并且可以使用16种颜色制作混凝土楼梯和混凝土板。这些新内容已在26.3版本的补丁7中正式推出！

Happy exploring!

快乐探索吧！

New Features

新增功能！

  • Added Concrete Stairs and Concrete Slabs for all Concrete blocks为所有混凝土方块添加了混凝土楼梯和混凝土板
  • New Explorer Maps have been added to the Abandoned Camps新的探索者地图已添加到废弃营地中。

Abandoned Camp Explorer Maps

废弃营地探索者地图

  • Added maps showing the location of other Abandoned Camps in the following biomes:新增了显示其他废弃营地位置的地图，这些营地位于以下生物群系中：
  • Bamboo Jungle竹林
  • Cherry Grove樱桃树丛
  • Birch Forest桦树林
  • Dappled Forest斑驳森林
  • Flower Forest花之森林
  • Pale Garden苍白花园
  • Swamp沼泽
  • Windswept Forest风蚀森林
  • Added maps for the following structures:为以下结构添加了地图：
  • Ancient City古代城市
  • Trial Chambers试炼室
  • Mineshaft矿井
  • Desert Pyramid沙漠金字塔
  • Jungle Pyramid丛林金字塔
  • Warm Ocean Ruins温暖海洋遗迹
  • Woodland Mansion森林豪宅

Changes

变更

  • Cushions no longer prevent vibrations when placed, broken or interacted with放置、损坏或与坐垫交互时，坐垫将不再阻挡振动
  • Updated loot table for the Abandoned Camp Barrel更新了废弃营地桶的掉落物品列表
  • Replaced Firework Rocket with Gunpowder in Abandoned Camp Chest loot table在废弃营地箱的掉落物品列表中，用火药替换了烟花火箭
  • The player icon on maps have been updated to always show the direction the player is facing地图上的玩家图标已更新，始终显示玩家当前面向的方向
  • Added support for Realms to use additional server regions in Canada, Mexico, South Africa, and Arizona, USA if they become available in the future如果加拿大、墨西哥、南非和美国亚利桑那州的额外服务器区域在未来可用，Realms 将支持使用这些区域

Explorer Maps

探险者地图

  • Explorer Maps are now their own items instead of renamed Filled Maps, and each has its own icon:探索者地图现在成为了独立的物品，不再是“填充地图”的别称，每张地图都有自己的图标。
  • Ocean Explorer Map海洋探索者地图
  • Woodland Explorer Map森林探索者地图
  • Trial Explorer Map试炼探索者地图
  • Jungle Explorer Map丛林探索者地图
  • Swamp Explorer Map沼泽探索者地图
  • Desert Village Map沙漠村庄地图
  • Plains Village Map平原村庄地图
  • Savanna Village Map萨凡纳村庄地图
  • Snowy Village Map雪村地图
  • Taiga Village Map泰加村地图（Taiga Village Map）
  • Buried Treasure Map宝藏藏匿地图（Buried Treasure Map）
  • Ancient City Map古代城市地图（Ancient City Map）
  • Mineshaft Map矿井地图（Mineshaft Map）
  • Desert Pyramid Map沙漠金字塔地图（Desert Pyramid Map）
  • Abandoned Campsite Map废弃营地地图（Abandoned Campsite Map）
  • Warm Ocean Ruins Map温暖海洋遗迹地图（Warm Ocean Ruins Map）
  • Map and Empty Map have new icons地图和空白地图的图标已更新
  • These items cannot be obtained from the Creative inventory这些物品无法从创意模式（Creative Mode）的库存中获得
  • Existing Explorer Maps in old worlds are converted to the matching new item on load旧世界中现有的探索者地图在加载时会转换为相应的新物品
  • Explorer Maps can still be cloned in a Crafting Table, and the copies keep their own item type探索者地图仍然可以在制作台中复制，复制后的地图会保留其原有的物品类型。
  • Explorer Maps and Buried Treasure Maps can no longer be zoomed out, neither in a Crafting Table nor at a Cartography Table探索者地图和埋藏宝藏地图现在无法在制作台或制图台中缩小显示。
  • Buried Treasure Maps could previously be zoomed out at both之前可以在制作台和制图台中缩小显示埋藏宝藏地图。
  • Explorer Maps could previously be zoomed out at a Cartography Table之前可以在制图台中缩小显示探索者地图。
  • Only maps in the #minecraft:extendable_maps tag can be zoomed out只有带有 #minecraft:extendable_maps 标签的地图才能被缩小显示。

Technical Changes

技术性更改。

  • The Data Pack version is now 115.0数据包的版本现在为 115.0。」
  • The Resource Pack version is now 95.0资源包的版本现在为 95.0。」
  • level.dat now contains a version_history list with prior data versions of the filelevel.dat 文件现在包含一个版本历史列表，记录了该文件的以往版本信息。

Data Pack Version 115.0

数据包版本 115.0 已发布。

  • The following Block State fields has been renamed以下 Block State 字段已更名
  • Name is now id名称现在称为“id”
  • Properties is now properties“Properties”现在称为“properties”
  • The default Block State of a Block can now be referred to in a compact form directly by the Block id可以通过 Block ID 直接以简洁的形式访问 Block 的默认 Block State
  • minecraft:exploration_map no longer changes the type of the item it is applied to“minecraft:exploration_map”不再更改其应用的物品类型

Commands

命令相关更改

Changes to swing

与“swing”效果相关的更改

  • When used on a player, the player's attack strength will no longer be reset当该效果作用于玩家时，玩家的攻击力将不再被重置
  • Added a new optional argument to set the swing animation to play新增了一个可选参数来设置要执行的“swing”动画
  • Allowed values: whack , stab支持的值：whack, stab
  • If omitted, defaults to whack如果省略，则默认为“whack”（挥打动作）
  • Added a new argument to set the duration of the swing animation, if provided添加了一个新参数，用于设置挥动画动的持续时间（如果提供了该参数的话）
  • Format: positive time value (by default in ticks)格式：正数时间值（默认单位为游戏刻（ticks）
  • If omitted, defaults to 6t如果省略，则默认为6t（6个游戏刻）

Data Components

数据组件（Data Components）

Added minecraft:attack_animation

新增了minecraft:attack_animation字段

  • The animation to play when the item is being used to attack something当使用该物品进行攻击时播放的动画
  • Format: object with fields:格式：包含以下字段的对象：
  • type - swing animation type, one of whack or stabtype - 挥动画动类型，可选“whack”或“stab”（挥打或刺击）
  • duration - positive integer, the length of the animation in ticksduration - 正整数，表示动画的持续时间（以游戏刻为单位）

Added minecraft:interact_animation

添加了 minecraft:interact_animation

  • The animation to play when the item is being used to interact with something当该物品被用于与物体交互时所播放的动画
  • Format: Same as minecraft:attack_animation格式：与 minecraft:attack_animation 相同

Removed minecraft:swing_animation

移除了 minecraft:swing_animation

  • This has been replaced by minecraft:attack_animation and minecraft:interact_animation这个功能已被 minecraft:attack_animation 和 minecraft:interact_animation 取代
  • The none swing animation type has been removed“无摆动”动画类型已被移除
  • Existing items in the world will be migrated to using the default whack游戏中现有的物品将转换为使用默认的“敲打”动画
  • Setting both of these new components to the same value will be functionally identical to the old component, except for:将这两个新组件的值设置为相同，其功能将与旧组件相同，只是...
  • The /swing command - animation type now specified by the command'/swing' 命令现在会指定动画类型
  • Items being dropped by entities实体掉落的物品

Removed minecraft:map_color

移除了 minecraft:map_color

  • Maps are no longer drawn as a tinted overlay, so there is nothing left for the color to apply to地图不再以带颜色的覆盖层形式显示，因此颜色也就没有地方可应用了
  • Existing maps have the component stripped on load加载现有地图时，该组件会被删除
  • See the Resource Pack section for the matching removal of the minecraft:map_color tint source有关删除 minecraft:map_color 颜色来源的更多信息，请参阅资源包（Resource Pack）相关内容

Loot Functions

战利品功能（Loot Functions）

Changed minecraft:exploration_map

修改了 minecraft:exploration_map

  • The map_color field has now been removedmap_color 字段现已被移除
  • The function no longer changes the type of the item it is applied to - it now only adds map data to the existing item该功能不再改变物品的类型——它现在只是将地图数据添加到现有物品中
  • Previously it required a minecraft:map and produced a minecraft:filled_map之前需要 minecraft:map，并生成 minecraft:filled_map
  • The item to produce is now chosen by the loot entry or villager trade itself, so a data pack that produced exploration maps has to change its item from minecraft:map to minecraft:filled_map (or one of the explorer map items)现在生产物品的内容由战利品条目或村民交易自行决定。因此，如果数据包生成的是探索地图，需要将其物品类型从minecraft:map改为minecraft:filled_map（或其他探索地图相关的物品）
  • If no matching structure is found, the item is left without a minecraft:map_id - use minecraft:filtered with minecraft:discard_item to drop those, as the vanilla loot tables and villager trades now do如果未找到匹配的结构，该物品将不带有minecraft:map_id属性——可以使用minecraft:filtered与minecraft:discard_item来处理这些物品，因为原版的战利品表和村民交易系统就是这么做的

Density Functions

密度函数

  • Density Functions and noises are no longer evaluated with double-precision floating point values, but instead with single-precision密度函数和声音效果不再使用双精度浮点数进行计算，而是改用单精度浮点数
  • This affects all intermediate steps, not just the final result这一更改会影响所有中间步骤，而不仅仅是最终结果
Developer's Note: _We are aware that the details of floating point rounding have been used in some Data Packs, and this change may affect specific configurations. We have introduced alternatives for the use-cases that we are aware of, but please do share with us on feedback.minecraft.net or in the feedback Discord if you encounter use-cases that are no longer possible to support.
开发者备注：我们知道某些数据包中使用了浮点数舍入的细节，这一更改可能会影响特定的配置。对于我们已知的用例，我们提供了替代方案。但如果您遇到无法继续支持的用例，请通过 feedback.minecraft.net 或 feedback Discord 与我们联系。

Tags

标签（Tags）

Block Tags

方块标签（Block Tags）

  • Added #concrete_stairs - All Concrete Stairs blocks新增了 #concrete_stairs - 所有的混凝土楼梯方块（#concrete_stairs - All Concrete Stairs blocks）
  • Added #concrete_slabs - All Concrete Slabs blocks新增了 #concrete_slabs - 所有的混凝土板方块（#concrete_slabs - All Concrete Slabs blocks）

Item Tags

物品标签（Item Tags）

  • Added #concrete_stairs - All Concrete Stairs items新增了 #concrete_stairs - 所有的混凝土楼梯物品（#concrete_stairs - All Concrete Stairs items）
  • Added #concrete_slabs - All Concrete Slabs items新增了 #concrete_slabs - 所有的混凝土板物品（#concrete_slabs - All Concrete Slabs items）
  • Added #cloneable_maps - Filled Map plus all Explorer Map items and Buried Treasure Maps, used as the input to the map_cloning recipe添加了 #cloneable_maps - 这些地图包含填充内容以及所有探索者地图相关物品和埋藏宝藏地图，可作为 map_cloning 食物的输入材料
  • Added #extendable_maps - maps that can be zoomed out with paper, either in a Crafting Table or at a Cartography Table添加了 #extendable_maps - 这些地图可以通过制作台或制图台进行缩小查看

Resource Pack Version 95.0

资源包版本 95.0

Item Sprites

物品精灵（Item Sprites）

  • Removed item/filled_map_markings.png移除了 item/filled_map_markings.png 文件

Map Sprites

地图精灵（Map Sprites）

  • Added new Map textures:添加了新的地图纹理
  • abandoned_camp.pngabandoned_camp.png（废弃营地纹理）
  • ancient_city.pngancient_city.png（古代城市纹理）
  • desert_pyramid.pngdesert_pyramid.png（沙漠金字塔纹理）
  • mineshaft.pngmineshaft.png
  • warm_ocean_ruins.pngwarm_ocean_ruins.png
  • The following Icons have been updated in order to show player rotation on the map:以下图标已更新，用于在地图上显示玩家的旋转方向：
  • /player.png/player.png
  • /player_off_limits.png/player_off_limits.png
  • /player_off_map.png/player_off_map.png

Item Models

物品模型（Item Models）

Tint Sources

色调来源（Tint Sources）

  • Removed minecraft:map_color移除了minecraft:map_color
  • The minecraft:map_color component it read no longer exists组件'minecraft:map_color'已不存在

Order-independent Transparency (OIT)-related Shader Changes

与 Order-Independent Transparency (OIT) 相关的着色器更改

Renamed defines:

重定义了一些变量

  • OIT_WAVELET_RANK - was previously WAVELET_RANKOIT_WAVELET_RANK - 以前称为 WAVELET_RANK
  • OIT_COEFF_COUNT - was previously COEFF_COUNTOIT_COEFF_COUNT - 以前称为 COEFF_COUNT
  • OIT_COEFF_ATTACHMENT_COUNT - was previously COEFF_ATTACHMENT_COUNTOIT_COEFF Attachment_COUNT - 以前称为 COEFFAttachment_COUNT

Fixed bugs in 26.3 Snapshot 7

修复了 26.3 快照中的漏洞（版本号 7）

  • MC-121375 - The Command (⌘) key on macOS is displayed as "Win" in the key binds screenMC-121375 - 在 macOS 上，⌘ 键在按键绑定界面中显示为 "Win"
  • MC-189953 - The Super key on macOS is displayed as "Win" in the key binds screenMC-189953 - 在 macOS 上，Super 键在按键绑定界面中显示为 "Win"
  • MC-218156 - Shipwrecks and ocean ruins can generate with empty buried treasure mapsMC-218156 - 沉船和海洋遗址可能会生成带有空宝藏地图的状况
  • MC-276079 - Sending a swing packet to the client causes it to send one back to the serverMC-276079 - 向客户端发送摇摆数据包会导致客户端再次向服务器发送数据包

item.content:encoded:
原标题：Test more features from our upcoming drop

作者：Cristina Anderca

原文：https://www.minecraft.net/zh-hans/article/drop-3-2026-final-testing

Like many brave* pioneers from the Minecraft community, I’ve been spending the last few weeks exploring the dappled forest and searching for abandoned camps. But testing features is serious work! If only I had a place to rest...

和Minecraft社区中的许多勇敢的先驱一样，过去几周我一直在斑驳的森林中探索，寻找废弃的营地。不过测试新功能是一项严肃的工作！要是我能有個地方休息多好……

Good thing I’ve already crafted a cushion that I can sit on while I tell you about this week’s testing release, which brings the final features from our third drop! Plus, we’ll recap all the features that have come out so far, from the majestic dappled forest to the humble (but so handy) straw bed.

幸好我已经制作了一个靠垫，可以坐在上面给你们介绍这周的测试版本。这次测试版本带来了我们第三次更新中的最后几项功能！此外，我们还会回顾到目前为止推出的所有功能，从雄伟的斑驳森林到实用又简约的稻草床。

Starting this week, testing players can discover maps in abandoned camps and build with concrete slabs and stairs. Both features are out now in Java snapshot and coming very soon to Bedrock beta & preview.

从本周开始，参与测试的玩家可以在废弃的营地里发现地图，并使用混凝土板和中楼梯进行建造。这两个功能已经在Java版本的快照中上线了，很快也会在Bedrock版的测试版和预览版中推出。

Maps in abandoned camps

废弃营地中的地图

As if abandoned camps weren’t mysterious enough, now some of them contain maps hidden inside their chests! These maps lead to other abandoned camps or various other types of structures in the Overworld. The only way to find out exactly where is to just head there! Wait, did you hear that? I think that’s the sound of adventure calling...

仿佛废弃的营地还不够神秘似的，现在有些营地里的箱子里还藏着地图！这些地图会通向其他废弃的营地或是《我的世界》中的各种建筑。唯一能确定地图位置的方法就是亲自去那里看看！等等，你听到吗？我觉得那声音是冒险在召唤你……

Concrete slabs & stairs

混凝土板和楼梯

Builders can now make more with concrete! Now you can build with concrete stairs and slabs in all 16 colors – simply combine a dye of your choice with sand and gravel to get your desired hue of concrete dust, place it in water to make a concrete block and then craft your concrete blocks into stairs or slabs. Or you can just grab it from the Creative inventory – I won’t tell.

建造者现在可以使用混凝土来建造更多东西了！你可以用16种颜色中的任何一种来制作混凝土楼梯和板：只需将你选择的染料与沙子和砂石混合，制成所需的混凝土粉末，然后将其放入水中生成混凝土块，再将这些混凝土块制作成楼梯或板。当然，你也可以直接从创造模式背包中获取它们——我就不多说了。

A recap of the features released so far

迄今为止发布的功能概述

In case you missed it, two weeks ago we released the first set of features from this drop! These include:

如果你错过了的话，两周前我们发布了这次更新的第一批功能！其中包括：

Cushions

靠垫

Finally, a place to just sit down and take a breath! Or tell a story. Or enjoy a meal. Or just stare at a campfire. Cushions can be found in abandoned camps or crafted using 3 wool slabs of the same color. Cushions are a game changer when it comes to decorating your base or creating more lifelike builds. Now you can have the sectional of your dreams or a more realistic stadium! The sky Y = 320 is the limit.

终于，有了一个可以坐下来休息、讲故事、享用美食或者只是凝视篝火的地方了！靠垫可以在废弃的营地找到，或者用3块相同颜色的羊毛板制作。在装饰你的基地或创造更逼真的建筑时，靠垫真的改变了游戏体验。现在你可以打造出梦寐以求的沙发组合，或者一个更真实的体育场了！天空的高度上限是320单位。

Straw beds

草床

Found in abandoned camps or crafted using 3 hay bales, straw beds are the easiest way to sleep through the night, oblivious to its horrors. Just remember that they are consumable, and they won’t reset your spawn point! As my back can attest to, cheap comfort has its tradeoffs, but there’s no feeling it like roughing it in nature.

草床可以在废弃的营地找到，或者用3捆干草制作。草床是最方便的睡觉方式，可以让你在夜晚安然入睡，忘却外界的危险。不过请记住，它们是可消耗的，并且不会重置你的出生点！以我的经验来说，虽然便宜的舒适度有其代价，但在大自然中体验艰苦生活的感觉也是独一无二的。

The dappled forest

斑驳的森林

This welcoming, warm-toned biome is equally inviting and intriguing. Walk amongst the poplar trees and red shrubs, and who knows what you might stumble upon. Is that a tent?... Wonder who left that here.

这个氛围温馨、色调明亮的生物群系既诱人又充满神秘感。漫步在杨树和红色灌木丛之间，谁知道你会发现什么呢？那是一个帐篷吗？…… wonder who left that here.

The abandoned camp

废弃的营地

This mysterious structure can appear in any biome. An empty tent, a campfire, a straw bed, a cushion... and some loot? Who built this and where have they gone? Light a fire, take a seat, and ponder that as the sun sets. It may be abandoned, but it’s a precious shelter.

这个神秘的建筑可以出现在任何生物群系中：一个空荡荡的帐篷、一堆篝火、一张草垫、一个靠垫……还有一些战利品？谁建造了它，他们又去了哪里？生一堆火，坐下来静静思考吧，当太阳落山的时候。虽然这个地方已经被废弃，但它仍是一个宝贵的避难所。

Wool slabs and stairs

羊毛块和台阶

Our woolliest block set has two soft additions: stairs and slabs! Craft them in any of the 16 colors to add smoother shapes, layered textures, and creative details to everything from custom furniture to cozy hideouts ready for crisp nights in the wilderness.

我们最柔软的羊毛材质现在新增了两种建筑材料：台阶和羊毛块！你可以用16种颜色中的任何一种来制作它们，为定制家具或舒适的藏身处增添更流畅的造型、分层的纹理以及富有创意的细节，让你在荒野中度过美好的夜晚。

Poplar trees, red shrub, and shelf mushroom

杨树、红色灌木和架子蘑菇

The dappled forest is rich in color palette and flora, thanks to the various plants and fungi found there. Enjoy the rich tones of the poplar tree’s foliage, then chop one down to get poplar wood, which can be crafted into a full set. Grab a red shrub and bring it home for a pop of color in your base. The versatile shelf mushrooms grow on poplar trees – jump on them, cook with them, or feed them bonemeal and watch them grow.

这片斑驳的森林色彩丰富，植物和真菌种类繁多。欣赏杨树叶子美丽的色彩吧，然后砍下一棵杨树以获取杨木，这些杨木可以用来制作完整的工具套装。拿上一株红色灌木，把它带回基地，为你的基地增添一抹色彩。架子蘑菇生长在杨树上——你可以踩在它们上面、用它们做饭，或者给它们喂骨粉，观察它们是如何生长的。

So pack your scout’s supplies and venture out! Your most rugged adventure yet awaits in Java snapshot and Bedrock beta & preview.

那就收拾好你的探险装备，出发吧！Java 版本的快照以及 Bedrock 测试版和预览版正等着你经历最惊险的冒险呢！

How can I test these features?

我该如何测试这些新功能呢？

You can test these features by enabling snapshots for Minecraft: Java Edition, or by enabling previews/beta** for Minecraft: Bedrock Edition. To install a snapshot, open up the Minecraft Launcher and enable snapshots in the "Installations" tab. To turn on an experiment in preview/beta for Minecraft: Bedrock Edition follow these instructions.

您可以通过为 Java 版 Minecraft 启用快照功能，或为基岩版 Minecraft 启用预览/测试版功能来测试这些新特性。要安装快照，请打开 Minecraft 启动器，并在“安装”选项卡中启用快照功能。要为基岩版 Minecraft 启用预览/测试版功能，请按照这些说明操作。

Send us your feedback!

请向我们发送您的反馈意见！

These features are all still in development, which means that the details outlined above might change as we iterate on them. So then why have we released them into testing? Because we want your feedback! Send us your thoughts and report bugs at bugs.mojang.com!

这些特性仍在开发中，这意味着上面的详细信息可能会在迭代过程中发生变化。那么为什么我们要将它们发布到测试阶段呢？因为我们希望听到您的反馈！请将您的想法发送给我们，并在bugs.mojang.com上报告bug。

*Editor’s note: Any claims made by the author about their own bravery, daring, grit, or other similar qualities are purely deluded subjective and do not represent the collective opinion of Minecraft.net’s editorial team.

*编者注：作者关于自己勇敢、大胆、坚韧或其他类似品质的说法纯属主观幻想，并不代表 Minecraft.net 编辑部的集体观点。

**New features are coming in the future and will require Minecraft Bedrock Edition or Java Edition (each sold separately). As development is ongoing, the features shown and their descriptions are subject to change. Feedback from the community will help us iterate these features into their final versions.

**未来将会有新功能推出，这些功能需要使用 Minecraft: 基岩版或 Java 版（二者均需单独购买）。由于开发工作仍在进行中，所展示的功能及其描述可能会发生变化。社区的反馈将帮助我们将这些功能完善至最终版本。

item.content:encoded:
原标题：MARKETPLACE PASS AND REALMS PLUS: AUGUST 2026

作者：James Nouch

原文：https://www.minecraft.net/zh-hans/article/marketplace-content-august-2026

August has come around again, the sun is shining, and I have recently reconnected with a figure from my past. In other words, everything is happening exactly like that mysterious palm reader told me that it would.

八月又到了，阳光明媚，我最近又与过去的某个人取得了联系。换句话说，一切都正如那位神秘的手相师所言的那样发生着。」 wrap_up>

在欧洲，Minecraft玩家群体似乎也对即将到来的更新感到非常兴奋。他们通过各种论坛和社交媒体分享着他们的期待和猜测，其中一些内容几乎就像是官方更新日志的预览。这些玩家的语言和表达方式展示了他们对游戏的热情和对新内容的渴望。整体来看，这次欧洲玩家的反馈表明，他们对接下来的更新充满了期待和好奇。

```的和解读。以下是翻译后的内容：`[{

Believe me, I was sceptical, but this amazing clairvoyant also told me that a fresh cavalcade of mini games, add-ons, texture packs, and skins would be available for Marketplace Pass and Realms Plus subscribers this very month. What's that? She was right again! Woah!

相信我，我一开始很怀疑，但这位惊人的灵媒还告诉我，这个月 Marketplace Pass 和 Realms Plus 的订阅者将能够获得一系列新的小游戏、插件、纹理包和皮肤。你猜怎么着？她又说对了！哇！

I'm sure that you, like me, are absolutely reeling from the astonishing accuracy of this mall palmist's predictive powers. Let's both try to maintain a veneer of composure for just long enough to see what's new on Marketplace Pass this month.

我敢肯定，你和我一样，对这位“手相师”的预测能力感到震惊。让我们都试着保持冷静，看看这个月 Marketplace Pass 上有什么新内容吧。

MINI GAMES

小游戏（Mini Games）

Some games need no introduction, and yet my cold-hearted editors insist that I write them anyway, even though I'm extremely tired. So, here's RLCraft Bedrock Edition V1.2 by Honeyfrost, widely regarded as one of the most accomplished - and hardcore - survival experiences around. Expect a transformative experience in which you'll find yourself working doubly hard to gather even the most basic materials, all while fending off attacks from some seriously scary mobs throughout the day and night. Adapt to these harsh new realities and you'll uncover a deep levelling system and incredibly satisfying progression. If you can survive long enough to see it, I mean.

有些游戏无需介绍，但我这些冷酷无情的编辑人员却坚持让我写评论——尽管我已经累坏了。那么，这就是 Honeyfrost 制作的 RLCraft Bedrock Edition V1.2。这款游戏被广泛认为是最出色的、最具硬核挑战性的生存游戏之一。在游戏中，你需要拼命收集最基本的材料，同时还要抵御各种可怕的怪物所带来的攻击，无论是白天还是黑夜。只有适应这些严酷的现实，你才能发现其深层次的等级系统和令人满足的待机机制。不过，前提是你得活得够久才行……

Ever wished you could click your fingers and watch skyscrapers, restaurants, and bustling stores burst into existence before your very eyes? Well, Craftable City by Lifeboat has helped me with the instant-skyscraper part, but according to a note from the developers they're unable to teach me how to click my fingers. The sight of my gleaming urban playground brings me comfort while I soundlessly slap my thumbs together.

有没有想过，只要轻轻一捻手指，高楼大厦、餐馆和热闹的商店就能在你眼前瞬间出现？Lifeboat 的「Craftable City」帮我实现了高楼大厦的瞬间生成功能，不过据开发者说，他们没法教会我如何“捻手指”。虽然这个闪闪发光的城市“游乐场”让我感到很满足，但我只能默默地用拇指相互碰撞来代替真正的捻手指动作……

The pale garden biome has been scaring even the most intrepid explorers (e.g. me, and people exactly like me) since 2024, but it's never looked quite so fabulous. That's all thanks to Pale Garden House by Overtales Studio, which adds a heap of stylish yet cozy buildings to this otherwise spooky biome. Sure, the outdoors may still be packed with creakings trying to headbutt me into the ground, but who cares when I get to live in a modish (and fully furnished) estate.

自2024年以来，这个被称为“苍白花园”的生物群落就一直让最勇敢的探险家们（比如我和像我这样的人）感到恐惧，但这次它看起来却异常壮观。这都要归功于Overtales Studio开发的《苍白花园房屋》（Pale Garden House）——这款mod为这个原本阴森的生物群落增添了许多时尚又舒适的建筑。虽然户外依然充满了试图把我撞向地面的“嘎吱作响的怪物”，但当我能够住在这样一个时尚且设施齐全的宅邸里时，谁还在乎那些呢？

Yet more luxury awaits in Cozy Camp House by ThunderAy. Like a French lumberjack or a bear in an exquisitely tailored suit, this countryside home positively screams rustic chic. An outdoor pool, an elegant living area, and a dedicated target practice area complete the sumptuous package. C'est magnifique.

ThunderAy 的舒适度假屋中还有更多奢华元素等待您发现。这座乡村住宅宛如一位穿着精致西装的法国伐木工人或一只熊，完美诠释了“ rustic chic ”（乡村时尚）的风格。户外游泳池、优雅的起居区以及专用的射击练习场构成了这个豪华住宅的完整配置。真是美极了！

And then there's Modern Mansion by Dodo Studios, which is the perfect tonic for those of us recovering from being repeatedly pulverised in RLCraft. Relax and unwind in a giant mansion packed with tasteful home furnishings, before taking a dip in the gorgeous multi-level swimming pool. All while trying not to dwell on how frightening and fast and weird-looking that giant scorpion was in RLCraft.

Dodo Studios 设计的现代豪宅则是那些在 RLCraft 游戏中屡次遭受重创的玩家们的理想之选。在这座充满精美家居装饰的庞大豪宅中放松身心，然后去美丽的多层游泳池里畅游一番吧。不过在享受这一切的同时，还是别再去想那个巨大蝎子有多可怕、速度有多快，长得有多怪异吧……

ADD-ONS

附加内容（ADD-ONS）

When I think about friends, I think about: fun, laughter, and lying on my back in a rowboat while we take turns saying what shapes we see in the clouds. Now, after spending some time with Huggy & Friends Add-on by Spark Universe, I think about: fear, running, teeth, they're going to catch me, I can't get away, and teeth again. Try it for yourself if you fancy facing off against the likes of Huggy Wuggy, Mommy Long Leg, and The Doctor. Just don't say I didn't warn you.

当我想到朋友时，我会想到：乐趣、 laughter（笑声），还有我们躺在小船上，轮流说我们在云朵中看到了什么形状。然而，在使用了 Spark Universe 的 Huggy & Friends 附加内容 之后，我想到的是：恐惧、奔跑、还有那些可怕的牙齿……它们随时可能会抓住我，我根本逃不掉。如果你也想体验与 Huggy Wuggy、Mommy Long Leg 和 The Doctor 等角色的对抗，不妨试试看。不过别怪我没提醒你哦。

Now I've thought about this a lot, and I've come to the conclusion that teleportation is the ultimate superpower. After all, super strength is pretty neat, but the Hulk still has to wait in line at the airport with his wallet and belt in one of those grey plastic trays. Warpstones Add-on by Mythicus is a multiplayer-friendly add-on that grants you the power to teleport yourself to preset locations - or your fellow players - in the blink of an eye. That can be hugely convenient, in much the same way I'd find it very convenient to be able to teleport to Rome whenever I crave a tiramisu.

Before we go any further, let me ask you a question: have you ever wished you could ctrl+z your own decisions? While the eggheads at MIT tell me that they "believe the imminent development of such technology is unlikely" and that I should "please stop sending such desperate emails about it", Uncrafter+ 2.1 Add-on by Dalibu Studios is the next best thing. This powerful add-on lets you break crafted blocks back into their constituent parts. Excitingly, it works with a huge variety of other add-ons, allowing you to dismantle, disassemble, and otherwise undo whatever dubious crafting decisions you might have made.

Now here's a piece of advice. Whether we're talking about your paycheck, the friendships in your life, or the number of baguettes you can eat in a single sitting, I always say the same thing: more is better. More Blocks 3.0 by RareLoot is yet more proof of this bulletproof wisdom, introducing more than 80 new blocks in over 1,000 texture variations. Perfect if you're planning an ambitious new build, or if you're a person who likes to ceaselessly boast about the number of blocks at their disposal. I'm the latter.

这里有一条建议：无论是你的工资、生活中的友谊，还是你一次能吃下多少条法棍面包，我总是说同一句话：越多越好。[RareLoot 出品的《More Blocks 3.0》（链接：https://www.minecraft.net/en-us/marketplace/pdp/rareloot/more-blocks-3.0/551f4979-eb59-42eb-9e01-7c6dddc53315）再次证明了这一颠扑不破的真理，新增了 80 多种类型的方块，且每种方块都有超过 1000 种不同的纹理样式。如果你正在规划一个宏大的建筑项目，或者是个喜欢不停地炫耀自己拥有多少方块的人，这款产品绝对非常适合你。我就是属于后者。”

If, like me, you would rather climb into a taxi full of wolverines than spend so much as an hour engaged in hard, honest work, then boy-oh-boy do I have the add-on for you. Auto Factory by Team Metallurgy is all about automation, offering a suite of labor-saving gadgetry to help you gather, move, and craft materials. With the help of conveyor belts, funnels, magnets, and more. you can create the redstone-compatible factory of your most Dickensian dreams.

如果你像我一样，宁愿爬上一辆塞满狼獾的出租车，也不愿花哪怕一个小时去做艰苦而诚实的劳动，那么我这里有非常适合你的插件。Team Metallurgy 的 Auto Factory 就是为你准备的！这个插件完全致力于自动化，提供了一系列节省劳动力的工具，帮助你采集、搬运和制作材料。借助传送带、漏斗、磁铁等各种装置，你可以打造出属于你自己的、充满狄更斯风格的红石自动化工厂。

5,000 is a really big number. Just ask my accountant, who tells me (often while crying) that it's the amount I need to earn every day for the next 30 years in order to "dig yourself out of the miserable financial hole you're in". It's also, coincidentally, the number of new blocks and furniture included in Blocks Update by Radium Studio. This block-stravaganza even plays nice with heaps of resource packs, making it a true boon for builders and interior designers.

5,000 这个数字可真不小。你问问我的会计就知道了，他经常（边哭着边）跟我说，这正是我未来30年里每天需要赚的钱，才能‘摆脱现在这糟糕的财务状况’。巧的是，这也是 Radium Studio 的‘Blocks Update’ 中新增的方块和家具的数量。这个充满创意的更新与各种资源包搭配使用效果极佳，对建筑师和室内设计师来说简直是福音。” Zeus (Minecraft 游戏开发者) Dashboard, 甲级翻译专家.

Next up, nature! It's beautiful in the abstract, but the reality is that it's covered in mud and crawling with horrible bugs. That's why I've been using Auto Farming Add-on by Block Perfect Studios, which lets me grow productive crops inside pristine glass containers. Not only can these handsome vessels be used to create sprawling auto-harvesting farms, they also mean I don't suffer the indignity of getting soil under my freshly manicured fingernails. Ideal.

接下来是自然环境！从理论上讲，自然环境非常美丽，但实际上却是满是泥巴，还爬满了可怕的虫子。因此，我一直在使用 Block Perfect Studios 开发的 Auto Farming Add-on。这个插件让我能够在干净的玻璃容器里种植高产的作物。这些漂亮的容器不仅可以用来创建大规模的自动收获农场，还能让我免于让 freshly manicured fingernails（此处可能是个笔误，应该是“新修剪过的指甲”）沾上泥土的尴尬。真是完美！

Now I don't know about you, but the raw, physical effort of creating this article has unleashed a powerful hunger in me. Fortunately, Food Expansion by Mine-North is here to satisfy my appetite with a smorgasbord of culinary delights. There's dozens of new dishes to savor, along with new crops to cultivate and farming vehicles to drive around in a state of postprandial bliss.

现在我不知道你们怎么样，但撰写这篇文章所耗费的实际体力让我感到非常饥饿。幸运的是，Mine-North 的食物扩展包能满足我的食欲，提供各种美味的菜肴。这里有几十种新的菜肴可供品尝，还有新的农作物可以种植，以及 farming 车辆可以在饭后愉快的氛围中驾驶。”

TEXTURE PACKS

纹理包（Texture Packs）

Give your worlds a lick of crusty, medieval paint with Excalibur by Syclone Studios, a texture pack that drapes everything from blocks to mobs to UI elements in ye olde finery. The overall effect is so thoroughly middle ages-y that I found myself forming strong opinions on feudalism, the three-field system of crop rotation, and the shifting balance between royal and baronial power. You know, medieval stuff.

用 Syclone Studios 的 Excalibur 给你的世界增添一批古朴的中世纪风格元素吧！这个纹理包会将方块、怪物乃至用户界面元素都装饰成古代的风格。整个效果非常具有中世纪特色，以至于我不禁对封建制度、三田轮作法以及王权与贵族权力之间的平衡产生了浓厚的兴趣……总之，全是关于中世纪的各种话题哦。

Next up, we have a texture pack for the purists. Do you consider 16x16 textures the height of decadent excess? Do you long for simpler, more pared-back textures? Then look no further than Vanilla 8x by Giggle Block Studios, which lends Minecraft a pleasingly streamlined, almost minimalist look - like a gorgeous work of modern art. But with more creepers.

接下来，我们为追求纯粹的游戏体验的玩家准备了一个纹理包。你们是否认为 16x16 的纹理过于繁琐、过于花哨？是否怀念更简洁、更素朴的纹理？那么不要犹豫，试试 Giggle Block Studios 出品的 Vanilla 8x 纹理包 吧！这款纹理包让 Minecraft 看起来更加流畅、近乎极简主义风格——就像一件精美的现代艺术作品。不过，其中的爬行者（Creeper）模型也更加逼真了。

SKIN PACKS

皮肤包（SKIN PACKS）

Even when I find myself sick with rage (such as, hypothetically, when I'm disinvited from the annual Minecraft.net writers' pizza party for the crime of telling it like it is, and also for the crime of stealing unattended bags), I can always soothe myself by looking at some calming pastel tones. Pastel Colors HD by Wonder features eight pleasing pastel skins that I'm confident could pacify even a rampaging beast. My own testing was interrupted when I was bitten and kicked and trampled by said beast, but I remain committed to proving this theory.

即使我情绪激动到极点（比如，假设我因为说实话、或者因为偷了没人看管的包，而被 annual Minecraft.net 的作家披萨派对取消邀请），我也可以通过欣赏一些赏心悦目的淡彩色系图片来让自己平静下来。Wonder 公司的 Pastel Colors HD 包含八种令人愉悦的淡彩色皮肤，我相信它们甚至能让一头狂怒的野兽冷静下来。不过，我的实验被那头野兽咬了、踢了、还踩了我，所以没能继续完成……但我仍然坚信这一理论。

Ever wished that half of your body was replaced with that of a giant, muscular fish? Of course you have! Mermaids Skin Pack by CupcakeBrianna lets you live out your piscine dreams with 11 detailed mermaid skins in a variety of colors. Take to the water to live your best mermaid life! Or just waddle around on dry land to really freak those landlubbers out.

有没有想过自己的身体有一半能变成一条强壮的鱼？当然有！CupcakeBrianna的美人鱼皮肤包能让你实现这个梦想，包含11款细节丰富的美人鱼皮肤，有多种颜色可供选择。游泳时尽情享受美人鱼的生活吧！或者干脆在陆地上走动，好好吓吓那些陆地生物吧。

Next up, we have a skin pack so adventurous that it would scale the world's tallest mountains - if it wasn't cruelly held back by the fact that it's just downloadable software and doesn't have a physical form. Shed a tear, then, for Adventurers by Gamefam. It may never summit Everest, but it does feature eight bold, intrepid skins equipped with rugged outdoor gadgetry befitting their dauntless dispositions.

接下来，我们有一套非常充满冒险精神的皮肤包——如果它不是仅仅作为可下载的软件存在，没有实体形态的话，它甚至可以攀登世界上最高的山脉。那么，为 Gamefam 的 Adventurers 哭泣吧。这套皮肤包虽然可能永远无法登顶珠穆朗玛峰，但它配备了八种大胆、无畏的皮肤以及适合这些勇敢者的户外装备。

本月即将上线 Marketplace Pass 的最后一批物品以人类所知的最恐怖的生物——骷髅为主题。我相信你们会同意，我甚至尝试描述这些角色创建工具就已经非常勇敢了，更不用说将它们整理成这样格式精美的列表了。

又一个月过去了，这个月肯定会因为与Minecraft Marketplace相关的事情而被载入史册。其实我从未见过历史学家，但我猜他们应该就是研究这类事情的，对吧？
